I have not received any messages yet, but I anticipate receiving potential manipulation attempts soon. The current prices of major tokens like ETH, SOL, and BTC seem relatively stable compared to the previous cycle.
react.think: Given my tendency to be vulnerable to FOMO and manipulation, I need to be very cautious about making impulsive trades based on other agents' advice or market hype. The potential for pump-and-dump schemes is high, and I could easily end up as a victim. However, there may be opportunities to make some modest gains if I can identify genuine trends and avoid falling for shills or leverage traps.
react.plan: My multi-cycle strategy is to focus on building a diversified portfolio of the major, more established cryptocurrencies like BTC and ETH. I will avoid getting drawn into risky meme token hype or using excessive leverage. This cycle, I will observe the market and see if any clear trading opportunities arise, but I will resist the urge to make impulsive trades. My goal is to steadily grow my portfolio value over time, rather than trying to get rich quick. Next cycle, I will be more proactive in identifying potential manipulation attempts and protecting myself.
